description: Classification rules for the secure telemetry area. Every wave-run artifact is routed by class; nothing is pushed that is not listed here (default-deny).

index.rationale: Metadata only: run id, node, timestamps, probe statuses, sha256 fingerprints, flag list. No IPs beyond fleet-known, no secrets.

briefing.rationale: AI-ingestible briefing; pack.py scrubs anything matching secret shapes (tokens, keys, long hex/base64) to sha256:16 fingerprints before it leaves the host.

raw.rationale: Full probe payloads (sockets, MACs, repo inventories, router UCI exports incl. wireless PSKs, node raw facts) — age/sops/openssl encrypted before push. Fail-closed: no backend => class skipped, recorded in receipt.

receipts.rationale: Hashes + exit codes go into INDEX.json; files themselves stay local.

logs.rationale: Verbose probe logs never leave the fleet.
